module_role: Project/title-block context and complete 13-page Poppler full-page visual-review ledger for the supplied SLAC LCLS-II-HE PCW skid drawing set.
scope: Complete review of the supplied 13-page, mixed mechanical/structural drawing set only. The record distinguishes existing, demolition, new and relocated source scope; it does not claim to include omitted electrical, controls-submittal or external specification documents.

project.name: B950/NEH LCLS-II-HE:EI
project.owner_context: Stanford University / SLAC; U.S. Department of Energy logo is printed in the title block.

project_location.note: The supplied title blocks identify B950/NEH and SLAC but do not print a street/city address; the location is preserved as source-archive metadata rather than title-block fact.

project.current_review_authorization: SLAC Building Inspection Office Construction Authorization (IFC), PRS# 26-058, shown with date 3/9/2026 on supplied pages.
project.revision_context: Mechanical pages visibly carry Bulletin 4.2 - PCW Skid Replacement - Installation, revision 7, dated 26 JAN 19; individual sheet logs also retain earlier bullets and page-specific revisions. Revision letters/numbers are not flattened into a single project-wide revision claim.

scale_semantics.finding: All 13 pages were reviewed. Scale is view-specific: plan/detail captions include 1/8 in = 1 ft, 1/4 in = 1 ft, 1/2 in = 1 ft, 1 in = 1 ft or NTS as appropriate. The repeating title block does not establish one safe global geometry scale for all mechanical and structural views.
scale_semantics.global_measured_takeoff_warning: The record preserves schedule and P&ID facts, not a geometric quantity takeoff. Any measuring tool must read the local caption/graphic scale of the individual view.

visual_review_pages.title: SYM, LEGENDS, AND GEN. NOTES
visual_review_pages.finding: Mechanical symbols, abbreviations, general construction notes, scope-of-work text and title-block/revision context; no populated equipment schedule or point list.

visual_review_pages.title: BASEMENT (NEH) - PROCESS PIPING OVERALL PLAN - DEMO
visual_review_pages.finding: Demolition plan including existing PCW skid/control-panel/instrumentation removal and protection context; not a new-equipment schedule.

visual_review_pages.title: BASEMENT (NEH) - PROCESS PIPING OVERALL PLAN
visual_review_pages.finding: New PCW skid plan/enlarged view, CHW/PCW routing, pump/PLC panel location and keyed installation notes.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL DETAILS
visual_review_pages.finding: Skid plan/isometrics, PCW custom manifold and pipe support details; manufacturer reconfiguration note is visible.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL SCHEMATIC - PCW
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing and new NEH PCW schematic with project flow/routing context; no standalone points list.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL SCHEMATIC - PCW P&ID
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing/new P&ID, typed I/O callouts, sequence of operation, alarm limits, Modbus-to-Ignition/EPICS wording and factory-versus-field I&C boundary.

visual_review_pages.title: MECH SCHEMATIC - PCW FLOW DIAG
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing/new PCW skid flow diagrams; confirms factory-provided I&C within the skid boundary.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL SCHEDULES
visual_review_pages.finding: Dense schedule sheet: pumps, pipe/duct installation, pressure tests, heat exchanger, VFDs, compressed-air regulator, grille, reheat coil, existing AHU, air separator, pot feeder, expansion tank, filter, riser utility and existing/new PCW demand.

visual_review_pages.title: STRUCTURAL SPECIFICATIONS
visual_review_pages.finding: Structural specifications and structural sheet list; contextual only for equipment anchorage/support.

visual_review_pages.title: BSMT - PCW SKID
visual_review_pages.finding: Basement PCW skid structural plan and equipment schedule/dimension context; not a BAS schedule.

visual_review_pages.title: STRUCTURAL DETAILS
visual_review_pages.finding: Structural framing/support details; one detail marked NOT USED.
